snippet.title: Shade Trailer
snippet.description:
You've just been murdered, and as a new ghost you need to find out why. Move between the worlds of the living and the dead, avoiding enemies and hazards. Uncover hidden truths and use your new powers to determine the fates of those around you. Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1461150/Shade/
